overview.heading: How an export runs
paragraphs: An admin picks a month and starts a DRY or REAL export. The shop loads that month's invoices, stores them as export jobs, and a background loop works through them two at a time.
A valid invoice is sent to the accounting system, in a REAL export only. Anything else waits for an admin in a manual queue.

glossary.heading: Job statuses
items: Valid. A REAL export has sent it.
glossary.footer: **DRY** runs the same steps but never sends anything.

diagram.heading: The flow
diagram.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A["Admin: Start export"] --> B["1 · POST /exports"]
  B --> Q[("jobs: PENDING")]
  Q --> W["2 · Worker loop"]
  W --> S["3 · Saving a job"]
  S -->|SENT, REAL export| R[("accounting API")]
  S -->|MANUAL| M["Admin in the job editor"]
  M --> R
diagram.caption: Invoices are sent only in a REAL export: automatically for valid ones, and by an admin for MANUAL ones.

steps.title: POST /exports
steps.why: Validates the request, loads the month's invoices, stores them as jobs and starts the loop in the background.

notes.text: Only one REAL export is allowed per month.
Builds the job queue from the month's invoices.
The loop starts without being awaited (step 2), and the response returns only the export id.

steps.title: Worker loop
steps.why: Takes pending jobs in chunks of 20 and processes two at a time.

notes.text: The next 20 PENDING jobs, in id order.
Two workers share the chunk through `shift()`. Each re-reads the export before every job, so a pause takes effect within one job.

steps.title: Saving a job
steps.why: An invoice for a customer with an open dispute goes to manual review. Otherwise the outcome is saved.
steps.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> PENDING
  PENDING --> SENT
  PENDING --> SKIPPED
  PENDING --> MANUAL: invalid, or customer has a dispute
  PENDING --> FAILED: error
  FAILED --> PENDING: retry
  MANUAL --> RESOLVED: admin saves

notes.text: A valid invoice whose customer has an open dispute becomes MANUAL with `CUSTOMER_HAS_DISPUTE`.
Only a REAL export sends invoices.
A transaction-scoped lock on the customer, so the two workers cannot check the same customer at the same time.
